title: High Council
notes: ~280 individual articles A-Z; very high KG value (each = concept node)

footnotes.text: “Revelation, 11 November 1831–B [D&C 107 (partial)],” in Revelation Book 1, 122–23,josephsmithpapers.org;Minute Book 1, 21,josephsmithpapers.org;Minute Book 2, 28,josephsmithpapers.org.

While early high councils primarily functioned in their stakes, the high council in the place where the President of the Church lived could function as a high council for the Church in the case of disciplinary appeals. SeeDoctrine and Covenants 102:27and “Revised Minutes, 18–19 February 1834 [D&C 102],” in Minute Book 1, 35,josephsmithpapers.org.
